answer: Sable Beacon Ledger: each agent must continuously hold a unique, verifiable radio beacon at a registered physical wharf, transmitting signed liveness pulses tied to that fixed location. Identity issuance requires the beacon’s factory-set key, which cannot be cloned or emulated off-site. At peak demand, the zenith of registration volume, operators must still procure and install separate hardware per identity, paying hardware plus installation and site fees. Faking N identities costs N physical beacons and N wharf leases, making mass sybils economically unviable.
